subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should Mattermost inbound recovery intentionally await one bounded server-thread fetch on the first cold turn of each stored session, and should this PR be selected over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93243?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well proven, but the first-turn latency tradeoff and choice between two open candidate implementations require Mattermost owner intent.

options.title: Land this PR
options.body: Accept the bounded first-cold-turn fetch and use this branch's session markers, local cap, and concurrent in-flight coordination as the canonical fix.

options.title: Prefer the sibling PR
options.body: Choose the sibling only after it is refreshed and proves equivalent response bounds, marker bounds, session rotation, and overlapping-turn behavior.

options.title: Decline server backfill
options.body: Keep the current context-loss behavior if an awaited recovery request is unacceptable on the Mattermost inbound path.

recommendation.title: Land this PR
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded first-cold-turn fetch and use this branch's session markers, local cap, and concurrent in-flight coordination as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent current-main history on the Mattermost monitor and client paths and is best positioned to judge the channel-specific latency tradeoff.
